drill: unplanned: laptop lid closed overnight (host sleep with brief dark wakes, ~05:50-13:40Z)

effects.consumer_crash_cause: Docker VM clock 15-30 min behind after each dark wake; AWS rejected signed requests (RequestTimeTooSkewed, AssumeRole signature expired). Fail-safe: no write with a wrong clock; Kafka buffered; recovered after resync.

root_cause: EventStreams ids carry timestamp = event timestamp + 1 ms (2620/2620 live events, incl. 17 out-of-order). Resuming seeks to the first event at or after that time, so not-yet-received events stamped at or before the last event's millisecond are skipped: same-millisecond neighbours (both losses) and out-of-order events (0.74% of 5.28M retained events; max disorder 30.5 s). Affects every reconnect and every restart. Not caused by the sleep: the first loss was at 04:06Z, before it.
history_scan: All other gaps in retained Kafka history are deliberate capture pauses (9/30-10/7, 10/7 overnight) or the D29 producer-crash loss (10/10 01:35Z).
audit_tool_fix: audit.collect now snapshots all topics' ranges at once (a canary landing mid-audit had faked a 535-offset trailing gap).
